titre: Devoir de synthèse n°2 - Anglais (7ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Last Sunday was a special day for my family. In the morning, we went to the countryside for a picnic. The weather was sunny and warm. My father drove the car and my mother prepared a big basket of food. When we arrived, we played football on the green grass and picked some flowers. At lunchtime, we ate sandwiches, fruit and cake under a big tree. In the afternoon, we walked near a small river and took many photos. We came back home in the evening, tired but very happy. It was a wonderful day.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) Where did the family go last Sunday?   (1,5 marks)
2) What was the weather like?   (1,5 marks)
3) Give two activities the family did.   (1,5 marks)
4) How did they feel at the end of the day?   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verbs in the past simple: We (play) ______ football and (eat) ______ sandwiches.   (2 marks)
2) Give the past simple of: go ______ ; take ______.   (2 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "happy" = ______.   (1 mark)
4) Complete with a linker (and / but): They were tired ______ very happy.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
Write about a nice day you spent with your family or friends (about 10 lines). Say where you went, what you did and how you felt. Use the past simple.
